title: Elks Secure Playoff Berth With Dominant Victory Over Stampeders
summary: The Edmonton Elks have clinched a playoff spot following a decisive 53-16 victory against the Calgary Stampeders. This win marks the end of a significant playoff drought for the Elks. The game's outcome was a clear indicator of the Elks' performance, securing their advancement in the competition.
summary_points: The Edmonton Elks defeated the Calgary Stampeders with a score of 53-16.
This victory secured the Elks a spot in the playoffs.
The win ended a notable playoff drought for the Elks.
title_hi: एल्क्स ने स्टैम्पेडर्स पर 53-16 की जीत के साथ प्लेऑफ़ में जगह बनाई

summary_points_hi: एडमोंटन एल्क्स ने कैलगरी स्टैम्पेडर्स को 53-16 के स्कोर से हराया।
इस जीत ने एल्क्स के लिए प्लेऑफ़ में जगह पक्की कर ली।
